title: Admission Counsellor
description:
About Kingston Educational Institute
 



  





 Kingston Educational Institute, under the helm of Late Utpal Bhattacharjee and Smt. Uma Bhattacharjee, has performed excellent and notable work in imparting education in West Bengal. The society has established and administered several institutions since 2004, including a Polytechnic College, Science Degree College, Management College, 5 Years' Law College, Teachers' Training College, and a model school affiliated to CISCE — all located on a single campus of approximately 28 acres at Nilgunj, Barasat, District North 24\-Parganas. The society has since extended its activities with the establishment and administration of a 3 Years' Law College at the Madhyamgram Campus. Today, Kingston is a multi\-disciplinary institution offering a diverse range of undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, and professional programs across Law, Engineering, Management, Healthcare, Hospitality, and Applied Sciences, backed by strong training, placement, and skill development support. Programs Offered: Law, LL.B, LL.M Diploma in Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Automobile, Telecommunication) B.Sc., BBA, BCA BHM \& Hotel Management Hospital Management Computer Application Food and Nutrition Microbiology Bio\-Chemistry B.Ed. \& Education Training \& Placement, Grooming, and Skill Development Programs
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Counsel prospective students and parents in person, over phone, and via email/WhatsApp regarding available courses (LL.B, LL.M, Diploma Engineering, B.Sc., BBA, BCA, BHM, Hospital Management, Computer Application, Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Automobile, Telecommunication, Food and Nutrition, Microbiology, Bio\-Chemistry, B.Ed., and HotelManagement).
 



  





 Explain course structure, eligibility criteria, fee structure, scholarships, and career prospects for each department. Convert inquiries and leads into confirmed admissions by achieving individual and team admission targets.
 



  





 Follow up consistently with prospective students through calls, messages, and campus visits. Maintain and update student inquiry/lead data (CRM/Excel/Admission software) accurately and in a timely manner.
 



  





 Organize and participate in admission drives, education fairs, school/college visits, and seminars to generate leads. Coordinate with the marketing team for promotional activities, campaigns, and events to boost admissions.
 



  





 Guide students through documentation, application forms, entrance requirements, and fee payment procedures. Liaise with the Training \& Placement and Academic departments to communicate accurate program information to prospective students.
 



  





 Handle student queries and resolve concerns to ensure a positive admission experience. Prepare daily/weekly/monthly admission reports and share updates with the Admissions Manager.
 



  





 Build and maintain strong relationships with schools, coaching centers, and educational consultants for referrals.
 



  





 Required Skills \& Competencies
 



  





 Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English, Hindi, and/or regional language as applicable). Strong interpersonal and convincing/negotiation skills. Target\-driven mindset with the ability to work under pressure during admission season. Good knowledge of MS Office, CRM tools, and basic data management. Confident, presentable, and customer\-service oriented approach. Ability to multitask and manage a high volume of student inquiries across departments. Willingness to travel locally for admission drives and events, if required.
 



  





 Educational Qualification Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline (preference for candidates with a background in Education, Marketing, Business Administration, or Counselling). Experience Minimum 3 years of experience in education counselling, admissions, telesales, or student recruitment is required.

title: Founder's office
description:
Kingston Educational Institute
 



  





 Established in 2004 under the vision of Late Utpal Bhattacharjee and Smt.Uma Bhattacharjee, has been a distinguished name in imparting quality education across West Bengal.
 



 Spread over approximately 28 acres at Nilgunj, Barasat, the campus houses a Polytechnic College,
 



 Science Degree College, Management College, a 5\-Year Law College, Teachers' Training College, and a
 



 CISCE\-affiliated Model School – all under one integrated campus. The Society has since expanded its
 



 footprint with the establishment of a 3\-Year Law College at Madhyamgram, continuing its legacy of
 



 educational excellence. Furthering its commitment to public welfare, the Institute has also diversified into
 



 healthcare with the establishment of a Hospital, reinforcing its broader mission of service to the
 



 community.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 The Institute is seeking a dynamic and dedicated Assistant to the Founder's Office to directly support the
 



 President in strategic, administrative, and operational matters. This role demands high discretion, strong
 



 organisational ability, and readiness to represent the President's office across various institutional and
 



 external engagements, including extensive travel.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Provide day\-to\-day administrative and executive support to the President
 



 • Manage the President's schedule, appointments, meetings, and travel arrangements
 



 • Draft, review, and manage correspondence, reports, and official communications on behalf of the
 



 President's office
 



 • Coordinate with heads of various constituent colleges (Polytechnic, Science Degree College,
 



 Management College, Law Colleges, Teachers' Training College, Model School) for follow\-ups on
 



 directives from the President
 



 • Represent the President's office in meetings, institutional visits, and external engagements as required
 



 • Liaise with government bodies, regulatory/affiliating authorities (AICTE, UGC, Bar Council, CISCE,
 



 university affiliations, etc.) as directed
 



 • Assist in strategic planning, project follow\-ups, and monitoring of ongoing institutional initiatives and
 



 expansion plans
 



 • Prepare briefing notes, presentations, and MIS reports for the President
 



 • Handle confidential information with the highest degree of discretion and professionalism
 



 • Travel extensively across India for institutional, regulatory, and business\-related engagements on
 



 behalf of the President
 



 Candidate Requirements
 



 Criteria Details
 



 Base Location Kolkata (preferred)
 



 Willingness to Travel Must be ready to travel extensively across India
 



 Educational Qualification MBA (mandatory)
 



 Experience Prior experience in an executive assistant / chief of staff / founder's
 



 office role preferred (education sector experience an added
 



 advantage)
 



 Note: Given the nature of the role – extensive pan\-India travel, close coordination with the President's office,
 



 and frequent representation at external/institutional engagements – candidates comfortable with this
 



 travel\-intensive profile are encouraged to apply.
 



 Desired Skills \& Attributes
 



 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English and Bengali; Hindi preferred)
 



 • Strong organisational, coordination, and multitasking abilities
 



 • High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism
 



 • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and email/calendar management tools
 



 • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities independently
 



 • Presentable, confident, and capable of representing the President's office externally
 



 • Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (formulas, pivot tables, data analysis and reporting)
 



 • Advanced proficiency in MS PowerPoint (professional presentation and report design)
 



 • Working knowledge of HRIS (Human Resource Information System) and related HR\-tech tools
 



 • Proficient in advanced IT tools/courses and comfortable adapting to new software and digital systems

title: Senior Psychologist
description:
**Position: Senior Counsellor (Psychologist)**




**Location:** 
 Barasat, West Bengal
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Number of Vacancies:** 
 1
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Brainware University invites applications from qualified, committed, and ethically grounded professionals for the position of
 **Senior Counsellor (Psychologist)** 
 . The role is primarily focused on providing professional counselling and psychological support to students, while also contributing to student mentoring, emotional well\-being, academic adjustment, and overall campus wellness.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong clinical sensitivity, sound knowledge of counselling practices, ethical maturity, and the ability to work with students in a structured, confidential, and institutionally responsible manner.
 



  





**Educational Qualifications** 



* **M.Phil. in Psychology / Clinical Psychology is mandatory.**
* **RCI certification/registration is mandatory.**
* Additional certification or valid professional counselling license will be an added advantage.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Counselling \& Student Support** 



* Provide professional counselling support to students dealing with academic, emotional, behavioral, psychological, and psychosocial concerns.
* Conduct individual counselling sessions and group counselling interventions as required.
* Support students in managing stress, anxiety, adjustment issues, interpersonal concerns, motivation, self\-esteem, and academic pressure.
* Identify students requiring specialized clinical intervention and coordinate appropriate referrals wherever necessary.
* Maintain confidentiality, case documentation, counselling records, and follow\-up reports as per professional and institutional norms.
* Develop preventive and supportive mental health initiatives for students.
* Conduct awareness sessions, workshops, and wellness programmes on mental health, emotional resilience, stress management, and student well\-being.



  





**Mentoring \& Institutional Coordination** 



* Work closely with academic departments, mentors, faculty members, and administrative teams to support student welfare.
* Assist in developing structured student support mechanisms within the university.
* Provide professional guidance to faculty or mentors in handling sensitive student concerns, while maintaining confidentiality.
* Contribute to a safe, inclusive, empathetic, and supportive campus environment.
* Support crisis intervention processes as per institutional policies and professional ethical guidelines.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* Prior experience in student counselling, clinical practice, or institutional counselling setups is preferred.
* Experience in higher education institutions will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to psychological assessment, academic mentoring, student support systems, and mental health awareness initiatives is desirable.
* Experience in handling young adults, adolescents, or university\-level students will be preferred.



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong counselling, listening, and interpersonal skills.
* Sound knowledge of psychological theories, counselling techniques, assessment methods, and ethical practices.
* Ability to handle sensitive student issues with empathy, discretion, maturity, and professionalism.
* Strong crisis\-handling and referral judgment.
* Effective communication, mentoring, and student engagement skills.
* Proficiency in written and spoken English.
* Ability to work collaboratively with academic, administrative, and student\-support teams.
* High level of confidentiality, integrity, patience, and emotional stability.



  





**Mandatory Requirement** 




 Candidates must possess
 **RCI certification/registration** 
 and meet the required academic qualification criteria. Applications without the mandatory RCI certification may not be considered.
 



  





**How To Apply:** 




 If interested, please drop your CV to https://forms.gle/2BmMvHm8F9Yk94Uv8
